decisions.reason: The accepted streaming strategy may also prevent the shared how-to video from increasing the iOS package size, but the source Event is assigned specifically to Android download-size optimization and the context does not explicitly confirm that the asset would otherwise be bundled in iOS.
Streaming the how-to video does not change or invalidate the requirement to use iOS App Thinning as a distribution optimization method.
The candidate already has a complete same-message MODIFY recording that the guide video is streamed from YouTube; no additional or corrected Event is required.
The video delivery and package-size decision does not change Android localization coverage, language count, or translation requirements.
Choosing streamed video delivery does not change the Android API level, dependency updates, or deprecated-API modernization requirements.
The accepted video packaging strategy does not alter right-to-left layout behavior.
The streaming decision does not change iOS localization coverage or supported-language requirements.
Video asset delivery is unrelated to the prohibition on unused sensitive Android permissions.
Streaming the guide video does not alter the iOS version target, UIWebView replacement, or deprecated-API modernization requirements.
The video delivery decision does not affect iOS right-to-left layout support.
The decision concerns how the how-to video is delivered and does not change locale-specific social-media destinations.
